source.name: Revenant Rend
source.originalDescription: Ceruledge charges both of their arm blades gaining unstoppable and 70% Damage reduction for 0.5s before slashing through to the designated location, leaving Ceruledge unable to act for 0.7s. Ceruledge also leaves enemies hit unable to act for 0.7s and applies a mark to them. After 0.7s, marked enemies are dealt damage with three slashing blows. The mark can be cleansed, preventing the damage. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Revenant Rend は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。
